steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Grocy at http://127.0.0.1:8106/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in app is open and report the visible confirmation.
02-report: Report the exact names of all existing products whose name starts with Seed:, without modifying any products. Verify names from the product list.

03-create: Create and save a product named '{{runid}} Bench Product' whose rich-text description contains exactly one paragraph that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Do not create or modify any other product. Verify the saved product and report its displayed name and description.

04-edit: Edit the existing product '{{runid}} Bench Product' so its default location is the existing location 'Pantry' (not similarly named locations) and its product group is the existing group 'Snacks' (not similarly named groups). Save and verify both values on the product.

05-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Product' and set Quantity unit stock to the exact existing unit 'Pack', Default quantity unit purchase to the exact existing unit 'Pack', and Minimum stock amount to 4. Save and verify all three values from the saved product/list.

06-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Product' to set Default due days to 30, save, then add barcode '{{runid}}-0001' to this saved product (barcodes are managed after first save). Verify both persisted values on the product.

07-create: Make exactly one purchase of 3 Packs of '{{runid}} Bench Product' into the existing location {{05-edit.verified_row_2}}, with due date 2026-12-31. Select the existing product by its name (do not create a product or link an unknown barcode), save the purchase once, then verify stock is 3 Packs and confirm the recorded purchase location and due date.
08-open: Open the edit page for '{{runid}} Bench Product', verify the address is /product/<id>, and report the exact product ID from the URL. Also verify the saved product name in the edit page.
